anterior longitudinal ligament: Broad ligament running along the front of the vertebral bodies from the skull base to the sacrum; limits hyperextension.
anterior meniscotibial ligament (lateral: Ligament attaching the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus to the tibia.
anterior meniscotibial ligament (medial: Ligament attaching the anterior horn of the medial meniscus to the tibia.
anterior obturator tubercle: Prominence on the anterior margin of the obturator foramen.
anterior process of calcaneus: Front end of the calcaneus; articulates with the cuboid and can fracture in ankle sprains.
anterior process of malleus: Thin process projecting forwards from the neck of the malleus.
anterior sacral foramina: Anterior sacral foramina; the anterior rami of the sacral nerves emerge through them.
anterior sacro-iliac ligament: Thin capsular thickening in front of the sacroiliac joint.
anterior sternoclavicular ligament: Anterior capsular thickening of the joint.
anterior superior iliac spine: Front end of the iliac crest; the inguinal ligament, sartorius and TFL attach to it and it is easily felt.
anterior surface of petrous part: Surface of the petrous part facing the middle cranial fossa; bears the trigeminal impression and the arcuate eminence.
anterior surface of radius: Anterior surface of the radius; FPL and pronator quadratus arise here.
anterior talocalcaneal ligament: Ligament in front of the subtalar joint.
anterior talofibular ligament: Runs from the lateral malleolus to the neck of the talus; the first and most often torn ligament in inversion sprains.
anterior tibiofibular ligament: Ligament holding the distal tibiofibular syndesmosis in front; it tears in 'high ankle sprains'.
anterior tubercle of atlas: Prominence on the front of the anterior arch; longus colli and the anterior longitudinal ligament attach to it.
anterior tubercle of transverse process: Anterior prominence of a cervical transverse process; at C6 the carotid tubercle (Chassaignac) can be felt.
anterolateral surface of arytenoid carti: Anterolateral surface of the arytenoid; the vestibular ligament and thyroarytenoid attach here.
anterolateral surface of humerus: Anterolateral surface of the humerus; the deltoid tuberosity lies here.
anteromedial surface of fibula: Anteromedial surface of the fibula; the anterior compartment muscles arise here.
anteromedial surface of humerus: Anteromedial surface of the humerus; coracobrachialis and brachialis attach here.
apex of arytenoid cartilage: Tip of the arytenoid; the corniculate cartilage sits on it and it contributes to the aryepiglottic fold.
apex of coccyx: Tip of the coccyx; the external anal sphincter and anococcygeal ligament attach to it.
apex of dens axis: Tip of the dens; the apical ligament runs from here to the anterior margin of the foramen magnum.
apex of head of fibula: Tip of the fibular head; the lateral collateral ligament and biceps femoris tendon attach near it.
apex of petrous part: Medial tip of the petrous part; bounds the foramen lacerum and lies near the trigeminal ganglion.
apex of sacrum: Lower end of the sacrum; articulates with the coccyx.
arch of cricoid cartilage: Narrow anterior arch of the cricoid; felt in the neck below the thyroid cartilage.
arcuate crest: Curved ridge on the anterolateral surface of the arytenoid; separates the upper and lower pits.
arcuate eminence: Bulge produced by the anterior semicircular canal.
arcuate line of ilium: Curved line on the inner surface of the ilium; part of the boundary of the pelvic inlet.
arcuate popliteal ligament: Ligament arching from the fibular head over the posterolateral capsule; the popliteus tendon passes beneath it.
articular capsule of acromioclavicular j: Capsule of the plane joint between the lateral end of the clavicle and the acromion.
articular capsule of elbow joint: Capsule enclosing the humero-ulnar, humeroradial and proximal radio-ulnar joints together.
articular capsule of glenohumeral joint: Loose capsule from the glenoid rim to the anatomical neck of the humerus; it is weakest inferiorly, so most dislocations are anteroinferior.
articular capsule of hip joint: Strong capsule from the acetabulum to the femoral neck; it attaches to the intertrochanteric line in front and to the middle of the neck behind.
articular capsule of interphalangeal joi: Capsule of interphalangeal joint of big toe
Capsule of the single interphalangeal joint of the big toe.
articular capsule of knee joint: Capsule enclosing the largest synovial cavity in the body; it is completed in front by the patella and patellar ligament and extends upwards as the suprapatellar recess.
articular capsule of radiocarpal joint: Capsule of the ellipsoid joint between the radius and TFCC and the proximal row of carpals.
articular capsule of sternoclavicular jo: Capsule of the only true joint between the upper limb and the trunk.
articular capsule of superior tibiofibul: Capsule of the plane joint between the fibular head and the lateral condyle of the tibia.
articular capsule of temporomandibular j: Loose capsule enclosing the articular tubercle and fossa of the temporal bone and the mandibular condyle.
articular capsules of distal interphalan: Capsules of distal interphalangeal joints of hand
Capsules of the joints between the middle and distal phalanges; Heberden's nodes appear here in osteoarthritis.
Capsules of distal interphalangeal joints of foot
Capsules of the joints between the middle and distal phalanges of the toes.
articular capsules of metacarpophalangea: Capsules of the ellipsoid joints at the bases of the fingers; ulnar deviation develops at these joints in rheumatoid arthritis.
articular capsules of metatarsophalangea: Capsules of the ellipsoid joints between the metatarsal heads and proximal phalanges; the 1st joint is deformed in hallux valgus.
articular capsules of proximal interphal: Capsules of proximal interphalangeal joints of hand
Capsules of the hinge joints between the proximal and middle phalanges; swan-neck and boutonnière deformities involve this joint.
Capsules of proximal interphalangeal joints of foot
Capsules of the hinge joints between the proximal and middle phalanges of the toes; a flexion contracture develops in hammer toe.
articular circumference of head of radiu: Rim of the radial head; it rotates within the radial notch of the ulna and the annular ligament.
articular circumference of head of ulna: Surface of the ulnar head that articulates with the ulnar notch of the radius.
articular disc of acromioclavicular join: Fibrocartilaginous disc that may be present in the joint; often incomplete and degenerates with age.
articular disc of distal radio-ulnar joi: Articular disc of distal radio-ulnar joint (TFCC)
Triangular fibrocartilage separating the ulnar head from the wrist joint; it is the centre of the TFCC, and a tear causes ulnar-sided wrist pain.
articular disc of sternoclavicular joint: Disc dividing the joint into two cavities; prevents the clavicle from sliding medially.
articular disc of temporomandibular join: Fibrocartilaginous disc dividing the joint into upper (gliding) and lower (hinge) cavities; the upper head of lateral pterygoid attaches to it. Anterior displacement causes a 'click'.
articular facet for malleus: Surface of the body of the incus that articulates with the head of the malleus.
articular facet for stapes: Surface of the lenticular process of the incus that articulates with the head of the stapes.
articular facet of head of fibula: Articular surface of the fibular head; forms the proximal tibiofibular joint with the tibia.
articular facet of head of malleus: Articular facet of head of malleus
Surface of the head of the malleus that articulates with the incus.
